eyes_note: Two versions are recorded and neither is silently resolved: digital appearance (owner-chosen, both eyes healthy dark-brown) vs biological fact (real dog's right eye area fully white). The Guardian does not use eye colour as an identity check.
note: SYNTHETIC sample data for the demo. Not the real dog's history. Based only on the frozen twinpet_001 identity (coat, ears, tail) plus generic dog behaviour. No real private video, frame, audio or owner detail is used.

private_memories.text: The dog seemed to watch the rain from the window for a long time this morning — unconfirmed, single observation.

shared_memories.text: twinpet_001 is a cream-white dog with irregular light-tan markings, asymmetric semi-folded ears, and a mostly-white curled tail.
The dog is afraid of thunder. When thunder sounds it hides behind the sofa and whines softly until the owner sits nearby.
The dog's favourite walk is the small park two streets from home, in the morning.
The dog does not like being hugged by strangers. It steps back and looks at the owner.
The dog's name in stories is the twin's name only; the owner is 'the owner'. No other people are named in stories unless a shared memory names them.
The dog greets the owner at the door with a wagging curled tail and a short happy bark.
